correctness.rationale: The degree-six zonal polynomial and each squared inner product are explicit. Symmetry reduction gives m difference eigenvalues, m−n pair eigenvalues, n−1 repeated 2×2 standard blocks and one constant 2×2 block. Exact rational checker reproduced 304 assertions and independent full-matrix ranks n=3..6. The infinite result is algebraic, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The theorem closes a natural exact sixth-degree spherical-sampling problem on every normalized type-B root configuration. The non-invariant Gram rank reveals two genuine low-dimensional excess-nullspace exceptions, and proves dimension-uniform rigidity for arbitrary antipodally symmetric annihilating weights. This is stronger than the textbook invariant moment constraint; its complete rank and eigenspace classification can be reused when constructing weighted harmonic-index designs and interpolation formulas.
